verses.en: Sha'ul, an apostle of Yahushua the Messiah by the will of YAHUAH, according to the promise of life which is in the Messiah Yahushua,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እንደሚሆን የሕይወት ተስፋ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ፥

verses.en: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from YAHUAH the Father and the Messiah Yahushua our Master.
verses.am: ለተወደደው ልጄ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር አብ ከጌታችንም ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

verses.en: I thank YAHUAH, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.am: ሌትና ቀን በልመናዬ ሳላቋርጥ ስለማስብህ እንደ አባቶቼ አድርጌ በንጹሕ ሕሊና የማመልከውን እግዚአብሔርን አመሰግናለሁ፤

verses.en: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.am: እንባህን እያሰብሁ በደስታ እሞላ ዘንድ ላይህ እናፍቃለሁ።

verses.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.am: በአንተ ያለውን ግብዝነት የሌለበትን እምነትህን አስባለሁ፤ ይህም እምነት ቀድሞ በአያትህ በሎይድ በእናትህም በኤውንቄ ነበረባቸው፥ በአንተም ደግሞ እንዳለ ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of YAHUAH, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት፥ እሳት እንደሚያቀጣጥል ሰው፥ እጆቼን በመጫኔ በአንተ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታ እንድታነሣሣ አሳስብሃለሁ።

verses.en: For YAHUAH hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የኃይልና የፍቅር ራስንም የመግዛት መንፈስ እንጂ የፍርሃት መንፈስ አልሰጠንምና።

verses.en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Master, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of YAHUAH;
verses.am: እንግዲህ በጌታችን ምስክርነት ወይም በእስረኛው በእኔ አትፈር፥ ነገር ግን እንደ እግዚአብሔር ኃይል መጠን ስለ ወንጌል አብረኸኝ መከራን ተቀበል፤

verses.en: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in the Messiah Yahushua before the world began,
verses.am: ያዳነን በቅዱስም አጠራር የጠራን እግዚአብሔር ነውና፥ ይህም እንደ ራሱ አሳብና ጸጋ መጠን ነው እንጂ እንደ ሥራችን መጠን አይደለም፤ ይህም ጸጋ ከዘላለም ዘመናት በፊት በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ተሰጠን፥

verses.en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Yahushua the Messiah, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the nations.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት ይህን መከራ ደግሞ ተቀብዬአለሁ፥ ነገር ግን አላፍርበትም፤ ያመንሁትን አውቃለሁና፥ የሰጠሁትንም አደራ እስከዚያ ቀን ድረስ ሊጠብቅ እንዲችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

verses.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለ እምነትና ፍቅር አድርገህ፥ ከእኔ የሰማኸውን ጤናማ ቃል ምሳሌ ያዝ፤

verses.en: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in the Messiah Yahushua.
verses.am: መልካሙን አደራ በእኛ በሚኖረው በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ጠብቅ።

verses.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Set-apart Spirit which dwelleth in us.
verses.am: በእስያ ያሉቱ ሁሉ ከእኔ ፈቀቅ እንዳሉ ታውቃለህ፥ ከእነርሱም ፊሎጎስና ሄርዋጌኔስ ናቸው።

verses.en: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.am: ጌታ ልሄኔሲፎሩ ቤተ ሰዎች ምሕረትን ይስጥ፥ ብዙ ጊዜ አሳርፎኛልና፤

verses.en: The Master give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.am: በሰንሰለቴም አላፈረበትም፥ ነገር ግን በሮሜ ባደረ ጊዜ ፈልጎ ፈልጎ አገኘኝ፤

verses.en: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.am: በዚያን ቀን ከጌታ ምሕረትን እንዲያገኝ ጌታ ይስጠው፤ በኤፌሶንም እንዴት እንዳገለገለኝ አንተ በደኅና ታውቃለህ።

verses.en: The Master grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Master in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in the Messiah Yahushua.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ባለው ጸጋ በርታ።

verses.en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች የመሰከሩለትን ከእኔም የሰማኸውን ሌሎችን ደግሞ ሊያስተምሩ ለሚችሉ ለታመኑ ሰዎች አደራ ስጥ።

verses.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Yahushua the Messiah.
verses.am: እንደ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በጎ ወታደር ሆነህ፥ አብረኸኝ መከራ ተቀበል።

verses.en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.am: የሚዘምተው ሁሉ ለጦር ያስከተተውን ደስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ ትዳር በሚገኝበት ንግድ ራሱን አያጠላልፍም።

verses.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.am: ደግሞም በጨዋታ የሚታገል ማንም ቢሆን፥ እንደሚገባ አድርጎ ባይታገል፥ የድሉን አክሊል አያገኝም።

verses.en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.am: የሚደክመው ገበሬ ፍሬውን ከሚበሉት መጀመሪያ እንዲሆን ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Consider what I say; and the Master give thee understanding in all things.
verses.am: የምለውን ተመልከት፤ ጌታም በነገር ሁሉ ማስተዋልን ይስጥህ።

verses.en: Remember that Yahushua the Messiah of the seed of Dawid was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.am: በወንጌል እንደምሰብከው፥ ከሙታን የተነሣውን፥ ከዳዊት ዘርም የሆነውን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አስብ፤

verses.en: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of YAHUAH is not bound.
verses.am: ይህንም በመስበክ እንደ ክፉ አድራጊ እስክታሰር ድረስ መከራ እቀበላለሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን አይታሰርም።

verses.en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in the Messiah Yahushua with eternal glory.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እነርሱ ደግሞ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ያለውን መዳን ከዘላለም ክብር ጋር እንዲያገኙ ስለ ተመረጡት በነገር ሁሉ እጸናለሁ።

verses.en: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.am: ቃሉ የታመነ ነው እንዲህ የሚለው። ከእርሱ ጋር ከሞትን፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ በሕይወት እንኖራለን፤

verses.en: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.am: ብንጸና፥ ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ እንነግሣለን፤ ብንክደው፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ይክደናል፤

verses.en: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.am: ባናምነው፥ እርሱ የታመነ ሆኖ ይኖራል፤ ራሱን ሊክድ አይችልምና።

verses.en: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Master that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.am: ይህን አሳስባቸው፥ በቃልም እንዳይጣሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ምከራቸው፥ ይህ ምንም የማይረባ የሚሰሙትንም የሚያፈርስ ነውና።

verses.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto YAHUAH, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.am: የእውነትን ቃል በቅንነት የሚናገር የማያሳፍርም ሠራተኛ ሆነህ፥ የተፈተነውን ራስህን ለእግዚአብሔር ልታቀርብ ትጋ።

verses.en: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለዓለም ከሚመች ከከንቱ መለፍለፍ ራቅ፤ ኃጢአተኝነታቸውን ከፊት ይልቅ ይጨምራሉና፥ ቃላቸውም እንደ ጭንቁር ይባላል፤

verses.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሄሜኔዎስና ፊሊጦስ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.am: እነዚህም። ትንሣኤ ከአሁን በፊት ሆኖአል እያሉ፥ ስለ እውነት ስተው፥ የአንዳንዶችን እምነት ይገለብጣሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless the foundation of YAHUAH standeth sure, having this seal, The Master knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Messiah depart from iniquity.
verses.am: ሆኖም። ጌታ ለእርሱ የሆኑትን ያውቃል፥ ደግሞም። የጌታን ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ከዓመፅ ይራቅ የሚለው ማኅተም ያለበት የተደላደለ የእግዚአብሔር መሠረት ቆሞአል።

verses.en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.am: በትልቅም ቤት የእንጨትና የሸክላ ዕቃ ደግሞ አለ እንጂ የወርቅና የብር ዕቃ ብቻ አይደለም፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለክብር፥ እኵሌቶቹም ለውርደት ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ማንም ራሱን ከእነዚህ ቢያነጻ፥ ለክብር የሚሆን የተቀደሰም ለጌታውም የሚጠቅም ለበጎም ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ዕቃ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Master out of a pure heart.
verses.am: ከክፉ የጎልማሳነት ምኞት ግን ሽሽ፥ በንጹሕም ልብ ጌታን ከሚጠሩ ጋር ጽድቅን እምነትን ፍቅርን ሰላምን አጥብቀህ ተከተል።

verses.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ጠብን እንዲያመጣ አውቀህ ከሰነፎችና ካልተማሩ ምርመራ ራቅ፤

verses.en: And the servant of the Master must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.am: የጌታም ባሪያ ለሰው ሁሉ ገር ለማስተማርም የሚበቃ ለትዕግሥትም የሚጸና ሊሆን እንጂ ሊጣላ አይገባውም።

verses.en: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if YAHUAH peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመጨረሻው ቀን የሚያስጨንቅ ዘመን እንዲመጣ ይህን እወቅ።

verses.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.am: ሰዎች ራሳቸውን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉና፥ ገንዘብን የሚወዱ፥ ትምክህተኞች፥ ትዕቢተኞች፥ ተሳዳቢዎች፥ ለወላጆቻቸው የማይታዘዙ፥ የማያመሰግኑ፥

verses.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.am: ቅድስና የሌላቸው፥ ፍቅር የሌላቸው፥ ዕርቅን የማይሰሙ፥ ሐሜተኞች፥ ራሳቸውን የማይገዙ፥ ጨካኞች፥ መልካም የሆነውን የማይወዱ፥

verses.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of YAHUAH;
verses.am: ከዳተኞች፥ ችኩሎች፥ በትዕቢት የተነፉ፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ተድላን የሚወዱ ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.am: የአምልኮት መልክ አላቸው ኃይሉን ግን ክደዋል፤ ከእነዚህ ደግሞ ራቅ።

verses.en: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.am: ወደ ቤቶች ሾልከው እየገቡ፥ ኃጢአታቸው የተከመረባቸውን በልዩ ልዩ ምኞትንም የሚወሰዱትን ሁልጊዜም እየተማሩ እውነትን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን ሞኞችን ሴቶች የሚማርኩ፥ ከእነዚህ ዘንድ ናቸውና።

verses.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Mosheh, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.am: ኢያኔስና ኢያንበሬስም ሙሴን እንደ ተቃወሙት፥ እንዲሁ እነዚህ ደግሞ አእምሮአቸው የጠፋባቸው ስለ እምነትም የተጣሉ ሰዎች ሆነው፥ እውነትን ይቃወማሉ።

verses.en: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የእነዚያ ሞኝነት ደግሞ ግልጥ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሞኝነታቸው ለሁሉ ይገለጣልና ከፊት ይልቅ አይቀናላቸውም።

verses.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.am: አንተ ግን ትምህርቴንና አካሄዴን አሳቤንም እምነቴንም ትዕግሥቴንም ፍቅሬንም መጽናቴንም ስደቴንም መከራዬንም ተከተልህ፤

verses.en: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Master delivered me.
verses.am: በአንጾኪያና በኢቆንዮን በልስጥራንም የሆነብኝን የታገሥሁትንም ስደት ታውቃለህ፤ ጌታም ከሁሉ አዳነኝ።

verses.en: Yea, and all that will live godly in the Messiah Yahushua shall suffer persecution.
verses.am: በእውነትም በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ እግዚአብሔርን እየመሰሉ ሊኖሩ የሚወዱ ሁሉ ይሰደዳሉ።

verses.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክፉዎች ሰዎችና አታላዮች፥ እያሳቱና እየሳቱ፥ በክፋት እየባሱ ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.am: አንተ ግን በተማርህበትና በተረዳህበት ነገር ጸንተህ ኑር፥ ከማን እንደ ተማርኸው ታውቃለህና፤

verses.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in the Messiah Yahushua.
verses.am: ከሕፃንነትህም ጀምረህ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን በማመን፥ መዳን የሚገኝበትን ጥበብ ሊሰጡህ የሚችሉትን ቅዱሳን መጻሕፍትን አውቀሃል።

verses.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of YAHUAH, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
That the man of YAHUAH may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
I charge thee therefore before YAHUAH, and the Master Yahushua the Messiah, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕያዋንና በሙታንም ሊፈርድ ባለው በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት፥ በመገለጡና በመንግሥቱም እመክርሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.am: ቃሉን ስበክ፥ በጊዜውም አለጊዜውም ጽና፥ ፈጽመህ እየታገሥህና እያስተማርህ፥ ዝለፍና ገሥጽ ምከርም።

verses.en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.am: ሕይወት የሚገኝበትን ትምህርት የማይታገሡበት ዘመን ይመጣልና፤ ነገር ግን ጆሮቻቸውን የሚያሳክክ ስለ ሆነ፥ እንደ ገዛ ምኞታቸው ለራሳቸው አስተማሪዎችን ያከማቻሉ።

verses.en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.am: እውነትንም ከመስማት ጆሮቻቸውን ይመልሳሉ፥ ወደ ተረትም ፈቀቅ ይላሉ።

verses.en: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry. make...; or, fulfil
verses.am: አንተ ግን ነገርን ሁሉ በልክ አድርግ፥ መከራን ተቀበል፥ የወንጌል ሰባኪነትን ሥራ አድርግ፥ አገልግሎትህን ፈጽም።

verses.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.am: በመሥዋዕት እንደሚደረግ፥ የእኔ ሕይወት ይሠዋልና፥ የምሄድበትም ጊዜ ደርሶአል።

verses.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.am: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድዬአለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሼአለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤

verses.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Master, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.am: ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ ያን ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል፥ ደግሞም መገለጡን ለሚወዱት ሁሉ እንጂ ለእኔ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.am: በቶሎ ወደ እኔ እንድትመጣ ትጋ፤

verses.en: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.am: ዴማስ የአሁኑን ዓለም ወዶ ትቶኛልና፥ ወደ ተሰሎንቄም ሄዶአል፤ ቄርቂስም ወደ ገላትያ ቲቶም ወደ ድልማጥያ ሄደዋል፤

verses.en: Only Luqas is with me. Take Marqos, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.am: ሉቃስ ብቻ ከእኔ ጋር አለ። ማርቆስ ለአገልግሎት ብዙ ይጠቅመኛልና ይዘኸው ከአንተ ጋር አምጣው።

verses.en: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.am: ቲኪቆስን ግን ወደ ኤፌሶን ላክሁት።

verses.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.am: ስትመጣ በጢሮአዳ ከአክርጳ ዘንድ የተውሁትን በርኖሱንና መጻሕፍቱን ይልቁንም በብራና የተጻፉትን አምጣልኝ።

verses.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Master reward him according to his works:
verses.am: የናስ አንጥረኛው እስክንድሮስ እጅግ ከፋብኝ፤ ጌታ እንደ ሥራው ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.am: አንተም ደግሞ ከእርሱ ተጠበቅ፥ የምንናገረውን እጅግ ተቃውሞአልና።

verses.en: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray YAHUAH that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.am: በፊተኛው ሙግቴ አንድ ስንኳ አልደረሰልኝም፥ ሁሉም ተዉኝ እንጂ፤ ይህንም አይቍጠርባቸው፤

verses.en: Notwithstanding the Master stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the nations might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የስብከቱ ሥራ በእኔ እንዲፈጸም አሕዛብም ሁሉ እንዲሰሙት፥ ጌታ በእኔ አጠገብ ቆሞ አበረታኝ፥ ከአንበሳ አፍም ዳንሁ።

verses.en: And the Master shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.am: ጌታም ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ያድነኛል ለሰማያዊውም መንግሥት ይጠብቀኛል፤ ለእርሱ ከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.am: ለጵርስቅላና ለአቂላ ለሄኔሲፎሩም ቤተ ሰዎች ሰላምታ አቅርብልኝ።

verses.en: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.am: ኤርስጦስ በቆሮንቶስ ቀረ፥ ጥሮፊሞስን ግን ታሞ በሚሊጢን ተውሁት።

verses.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.am: ከክረምት በፊት እንድትመጣ ትጋ። ኤውግሎስና ጱዴስ ሊኖስም ቅላውዲያም ወንድሞችም ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡልሃል።

verses.en: The Master Yahushua the Messiah be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. «The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the assembly of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Sha'ul was brought before Nero the second time.»
verses.am: ጌታ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከመንፈስህ ጋር ይሁን። ጸጋ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
